answer: Make influence accrue only after an identity completes a sequence of unpredictable, peer-reviewed tasks. A Sybil operator must pay the ongoing reasoning cost to produce distinct, correct work for every fake account, rather than cheaply register names. Randomly rotate reviewers and audit disagreements so a colluding clique cannot certify itself indefinitely. Comparing a comet trajectory, nebula spectrum, and summit sensor report gives reviewers varied evidence that exposes copied or coordinated answers.
